sloka: भगीरथः तु राजर्षिः धार्मिको रघुनंदन ।अनपत्यो महारजाः प्रजा कामः स च प्रजाः ॥१-४२-११॥
transliteration: bhagīrathaḥ tu rājarṣiḥ dhārmiko raghunaṁdana ।anapatyo mahārajāḥ prajā kāmaḥ sa ca prajāḥ ॥1-42-11॥

translations.english: O delight of the Raghus righteous Bhagiratha who was highly lustrous rajarshi was without sons. He was desirous of progeny but did not beget children.
